question_1_idx_read_groups.answer: CONFIRMED: the die's one IDX unit (INDEX parent + static TOPK) reads ONLY the SW slice read group 4. Remove the IDX read group from SE, NW and NE (RG 5->4 SE, 7->6 NW/NE).
evidence: rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_vm_static.sv: one 8-bank face, sid input, non-mirror reads outside sid fault (never remapped); v15 binds sid=0.
historical ot_hgi_idx_unit_b2_ixw1.sv: native SW slot5 binding, ALL read operands REPL (mirror=1, sid 0), writes SW-owned.
ot_hbm_idx_topk_static.sv: reads mirror (REPL) or own-sid sectors only; illegal descriptor otherwise (benched).
INDEX keys do not come from VM: they arrive on key_lines (35,168 b) from HBM service staging, four stacks -> four scorers.
producer_obligations: INDEX query (128 x 1 KiB FP32 blocks) and head weights (2 sectors): written SW-owned (sid 0) or mirror (REPL).

TOPK route.top6 scores (route.scores_bias, 384 FP32/row): must be a REPL (mirror) word set or SW-owned. H-ELEM-B SU map address_map_deepseek_g25.json currently places route.scores_bias.O non-replicated in quarters 0,1,2 (128 words each) -> change to replica=true (SU.O mirror write, 3 x 128 extra ring words/layer) before the SE/NW group removal is final.
TOPK outputs O/R: SW-owned (sid 0) via the 'idx' record client; consumers outside SW need a mirror copy (o_mirror not supported in v1: ring ack calendar).

question_2_record_clients_SW_NC7.rule: cq338/cr274 slot kept only where a static successor actually issues packets; the hub record timing measured on the real slice: cq registered W, hub samples W+1 (bank_enable/bank_client), bank wslot WG+2 at W+3, bank echo W+9, response_enable W+10, cr at the client pin W+12 (local write). Reads by record are not used by any static client.

idx.successor: ot_hbm_idx_topk_static via ot_hbm_idx_client_static: O/R sector writes, client_seq = write index, ack checked W+12/W+13

su.why: static SU uses only the LG near station (ot_hbm_su_static_vm_ports, 4 bank-pair groups); no cq source

sfu.why: ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine uses LG mid tap local_rq/wq only

coll.why: ot_hfd_coll_q_static uses read group 3 + kq; the historical ot_hfd_coll_q vmq packet path is not in the static successor

hc.status: DEAD under the v15 engine rule
hc.why: HC engine binds to the LG far tap (18/15); its historical packet client (tb_hgi_hc_unit vmq) is not part of the static design. Confirm with the HC owner (hbm_hard_physical) when the far-tap engine source exists.

dma.why: VM-source moves are on read group 1 (ot_hgi_dma_back_static); VM-destination writes arrive on the service delivery dq. The historical mover's VM packet path (ot_hgi_dma_mover, 4 in flight) has no static successor; if VM->VM copies need a write port, reuse the idx record timing above, else remove.

argmax.successor: rtl/hbm_accel/generic/ot_hbm_argmax_static.sv: closed ot_hgi_argmax18_m (LP8) unchanged; VM rows read 1 sector/edge on SW read group 4 via the 3-owner share; STREAM beats on compiler edges (no am_rdy); O {value,id} two fixed-slot cq writes on SW record client 0, ack W+12; engine latency measured 14 and checked
